MeetingPlaybook.name: MeetingPlaybook
MeetingPlaybook.description: Represents a meeting playbook created from a meeting playbook definition. Specifies the sequence of stages and drives execution for the meeting.

Description.description: The description of the meeting playbook.

EventId.description: The event associated with the playbook.

LastReferencedDate.description: The most recent date on which a user referenced this record.

LastViewedDate.description: The most recent date on which a user viewed this record.

MeetingPlaybookDefinitionId.description: The meeting playbook definition. Specifies the structure and sequence of stages used to create meeting playbooks.

Name.description: The name of the meeting playbook.

OrganizerId.description: The user who owns or runs the meeting playbook.

OwnerId.description: The ID of the user or group that owns this meeting playbook.

RelatedRecordId.description: The API name of the related record that's submitted for approval.

Status.description: The status of the meeting playbook.
